packageRules.description: image/Containerfile is updated only by the custom managers for ARG BASE and ARG REPOS_BASE below. The Dockerfile manager would try to rewrite FROM lines built from ARGs (FROM ${BASE}, FROM ${REPOS_BASE}), so it stays off for this file.
Component pins move together, once a day, with no release-age wait: each is the main branch of an apex-linux repository, whose own CI has passed.

customManagers.description: ARG BASE=registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora-bootc@sha256:... in image/Containerfile (digest only; the tag it follows is 45).
ARG REPOS_BASE=registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora@sha256:... in image/Containerfile, the repos stage base (digest only; tag 45). A separate manager because the replacement template names the ARG.
The pinned commit of each component in components.lock (NAME GIT-URL COMMIT), following its main branch.
